verdict.rationale: The evidence shows machine-learning fraud scoring that drives block, allow, or review decisions on transactions. That is automated decisioning, not AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's data shown inside the product. The MCP server lets users query Adyen in natural language from their own external LLM client, so it is a developer building block outside the product and earns no credit. Backtesting and A/B experiments are user-run analyses, not AI-generated suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
